chunks: Al-Tawhid: My father, from Sa'd, from Ibn Isa, from Ibn Fadhal, from al-Halabi and Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Blessed and Elevated, is One, Compact, He does not have any hollowness, while the spirit is a creation from among His creations and is an aid, support and power which Allah places in the hearts of the messengers and believers.

key_terms.أَحَدٌ صَمَدٌ: One, Compact (divine attribute meaning solid without hollow)
key_terms.الرُّوحُ: The spirit (here defined as a created entity of power/aid)
key_terms.جَوْفٌ: Hollowness or cavity (used to negate physical form in God)
key_terms.نَصْرٌ وَتَأْيِيدٌ: Aid and support (functions of the spirit)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of God being 'Sadam' and what is the nature of the 'Ruh' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the attribute of 'Ahad' by negating physical cavity ('juf'), reinforcing the Shia doctrine of divine incorporeality against anthropomorphism. It further distinguishes the 'Ruh' as a created force of support placed in the hearts of prophets and believers, rather than a divine essence, aligning with the concept of *khuluq* (creation) in Shia theology.

en.ammaar-muslim: 7. [7/377] al-Tawhid: My father from Sa’d from Ibn Isa from Ibn Fadhal from al-Halabi and Zurara from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام who said:

Allah Blessed and Elevated is One, Compact, He does not have any hollowness, while the spirit is a creation from among His creations and is an aid, support and power which Allah places in the hearts of the messengers and believers.
